{{Citation}}
[[File:Bail_Organa_and_Mon_Mothma.jpg|thumb|right|220px|[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], two famous politicians]]
{{Quote|Politicians always have something to hide, and it always comes back to haunt them, am I right? Oh, look who I'm asking. Room full of politicians.|[[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|CSF]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tan Divo/Legends|Tan Divo]]|<ref name="SM">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>}}
'''Politics''' was the system by which a governmental being or body was governed. Those involved in governing and formulating public policy were known as '''politicians'''. Most [[Planet/Legends|planets]] had their own political system. Most political systems had their own constitution and law system. However, those systems that were part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] were bound by their allegiance to the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]].

Most planets had a [[Head of State/Legends|head of state]]—usually in the form of a [[King/Legends|king]], a [[Queen/Legends|queen]], a [[President/Legends|president]], a [[Prime Minister/Legends|prime minister]], or a chancellor. The head of state could be chosen by election, or by way of [[Noble/Legends|inheritance]].

Within many intergalactic governments, politics had become, in the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the Republic, saturated with corruption by politicians who focused on their own self-advancement and greed. This state of political affairs was exploited by at least two [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] ([[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]).

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] despised politics, preferring a direct form of government whenever possible. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Palpatine of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] tried to teach [[Gender/Legends|him]] lessons on politics from an early age, but he did not pay much attention to them. When, as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], Palpatine suggested to him that [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious was an invention of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to harass their political enemies, he argued that the Jedi were not political. To this, Palpatine replied that in a [[Democracy/Legends|democracy]] everything and everyone was political.<ref name="RoTS Novelization">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

As a rule, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] liked to leave politics to his sister [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>

[[Extragalactic/Legends|Extra-galactic]] politics also operated within their own circles, but these were far more parochial (as they existed or might be discovered in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] or in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]). Such narrow political views as were generally held by extra-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] politicians or aristocrats stood, perhaps, to benefit from exposure to more expansive regions and cultures, such as existed within intergalactic systems. [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] naval [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] (whose [[Core name/Legends|core name]] was "Thrawn"), was a progressive advocate of this more expansive outlook.<ref name="OF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> Thrawn expressed his political views to his brother Thrass in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]:
{{Quote|We have been granted a rare opportunity: the chance to meet and interact with members of a vast but hitherto unknown political entity [the Galactic Republic], people with insights and thoughts different from our own.... All thoughts are worth listening to, whether later judged to be of value or not.... But equally important are the social and intellectual bonds we are building between us. Someday, our Ascendancy and their Republic will make contact, and the friends and potential allies we create now may well define what direction that contact will take.|[[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] naval commander [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] (Thrawn) to his brother [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]] (Thrass).|<ref name="OF" />}}
